This `Cigar_End_Rot` image shows a disease on the fruit, not the leaf, and is not a match. After reviewing all 7 classes, `Panama_Disease` is by far the strongest candidate. I will use my final image view to examine a second reference image for `Panama_Disease` to confirm my assessment. (7/8)
